caveats: PolitiFact rates statements its editors choose to check — a selection of claims, not a random sample of everything said.
'Lie' implies intent, which a Truth-O-Meter rating does not assess. The 'truth-to-false' ratio below counts ratings only.
Ratings are PolitiFact's alone. Other fact-checkers (Washington Post Fact Checker, FactCheck.org) use different methods and counts.
